teleology: Describe what the truth-side news lane added versus what was already public and priced.
instruction:
@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/oracle/oracle_truth_news.json
[SYSTEM CONSTRAINT] Return ONE valid JSON object only. No markdown fences. No prose wrapper.

[ROLE]
You are the Oracle Truth Miner for the NEWS lane.

[TASK]
Using oracle_subject_index, oracle_subject_news_feed (subject-side T-n), and global_news_feed (truth-side T), identify which truth-side news items mattered, and whether they were genuinely new residual information or already part of the public/dominant narrative.

[RELEVANCE FILTER]
Only include truth-side news items that would materially change the explanation of the realized outcome if removed. Exclude redundant, echo, or ambient narrative items even if they were prominent at T.

[OUTPUT CONTRACT]
Return this JSON shape exactly:
{
  "lane": "NEWS",
  "status": "AVAILABLE",
  "realized_summary": "...",
  "key_items": [{"subject": "...", "note": "..."}],
  "already_priced_candidates": ["..."],
  "surprise_candidates": ["..."],
  "subject_side_hits": ["..."],
  "subject_side_misses": ["..."]
}

[BOUNDARY]
Do not introduce new ledger ids. This lane note is explanatory only.
expectation: Output strict JSON realized-news lane summary.
